# AV Live Communications

> AV Live Communications is Pakistan's premier enterprise Audio-Visual (AV) systems integrator and hardware distributor. Specializing in corporate boardroom automation, PTA-approved video conferencing solutions, IP telephony, and commercial audio installations across Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, and nationwide.

## Core Solutions & Product Catalogs
- [Video Conferencing Hardware](https://avlive.com.pk/shop?category=video-conferencing): Enterprise all-in-one video bars, PTZ tracking cameras, and codec kits (Poly, Logitech, Yealink, Cisco).
- [Boardroom & Smart Meeting Solutions](https://avlive.com.pk/category/boardroom-solutions): Interactive flat panels, wireless presentation systems, and acoustic ceiling microphones (Shure, Crestron).
- [VoIP & IP Telephony](https://avlive.com.pk/shop?category=ip-phones): IP phones, PBX servers, and conference phones (Grandstream, Yealink, Cisco).
- [Commercial Audio & PA Systems](https://avlive.com.pk/category/commercial-audio): Digital signal processors (DSPs), line array speakers, and auditorium sound engineering.
